scope: Return a privacy-refused public web search to the model as a bounded tool result instead of failing the reply run, so the model can retry with fresh wording.
motivation: Live verification found both web-search probes failed after the disclosure acknowledgment: the model naturally copies topical words from the triggering message ("top nasa headline", "space news this week"), admitPublicQuery correctly refused the shared n-grams, and the thrown error ended the run. A refused query never left the machine, but the person got an ack then silence.

design.feedback: admitPublicQuery remains the mechanical egress gate; a refused query is now a tool result {error:"query-not-admitted"} fed back to the model inside the same reply run, which may compose a fresh public query.
design.budget: Only executed searches consume the one-search inventory: web-search stays listed until an admitted query actually calls the provider; the dispatch loop and its two-tool bound are unchanged.
design.guidance: The model-facing rule now states the mechanical constraint (no shared two- or three-word span with any private conversation text) and that a refusal returns query-not-admitted for a fresh phrasing.
design.failures: A disabled plan still throws Web search is disabled; an unavailable tool kind still throws; a model that never settles still exhausts the existing dispatch bound.

independentReview.method: Implementer self-review of the full diff only.
